summary.text: Mekyah McQueen is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 61 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A high school math teacher, she earned a bachelor's degree in mathematics from Spelman College.

paragraphs.text: McQueen earned a bachelor's degree in mathematics from Spelman College and a graduate degree from Georgia State University.
Her career experience includes working as a high school math teacher, and as of her 2024 campaign she served on the board of TAMTAM Global.
McQueen succeeded Roger Bruce in District 61, assuming office on January 13, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Code Revision Committee, the Creative Arts & Entertainment Committee and the Special Rules Committee.
